secrets.name: SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Flask session-signing secret key. Any random string.

secrets.name: AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Key for an AI provider (e.g. OpenAI) used by the /api/chat endpoint. Optional — the endpoint returns a demo response without it.

secrets.name: GITHUB_USERNAME
secrets.description: Your GitHub username (public, not a secret). Used to fetch your repos and recent activity for the portfolio's GitHub section.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional GitHub personal access token for higher API rate limits (60/hr without, 5000/hr with).
